user.title: Set up Frickeldave Store
user.description: One line per Home Assistant user, for example `ha_user_id: product,app_admin`. Without a grant the default is deny.

data_description.users: Roles: product (catalogue), finance, app_admin (settings and grants).

error.invalid_users: Invalid grants. Use one line per user in the format `ha_user_id: role,role` with roles product, finance or app_admin.

data.stock_locations: Storage locations (one per line, order matters)

data_description.users: One line per user, for example `ha_user_id: product,finance,app_admin`.
data_description.stock_locations: One line per storage location, for example “Lager” and “Verkaufsschrank”. Line 1 becomes `stock` in the website export, line 2 becomes `salesCabinet`. Renaming keeps stock; deleting is rejected while stock is booked there.
data_description.ai_endpoint: Full URL of the chat completions API.
data_description.ai_api_key: Never returned, logged or exported. Leave empty to keep the stored key.
data_description.ai_prompt: Default: “Generiere mir eine schöne Beschreibung des Artikels für meinen Handmade-Shop.”
data_description.export_path: The export writes the catalogue to public/data/handmade.json and images to src/assets/handmade/, relative to the configured directory.
data_description.data_path: config: included in Home Assistant backups (default). share/media: excluded from backups, separate backup required; the directory must be mounted.
data_description.github_repository: Website repository. Commits go to the integration branch; main is only updated by the fd-deploy-prd workflow.
data_description.github_dev_branch: Branch for publications. A commit here triggers fd-ci and fd-deploy-dev.
data_description.github_prod_workflow: Workflow that promotes dev to main and deploys production.
data_description.github_token: Fine-grained token with Contents: write and Actions: write. Never returned, logged or exported. Leave empty to keep the stored token.

error.invalid_users: Invalid grants. Use one line per user in the format `ha_user_id: role,role` with roles product, finance or app_admin.
error.invalid_data_path: The data location is not available or not writable. For share/media the directory must be mounted as a volume.
error.target_not_empty: The target directory already contains catalogue data. Empty it or choose another location.
error.invalid_locations: Invalid storage locations. At least one, no empty or duplicate names (max. 40 characters).
error.location_in_use: A storage location still holds stock and cannot be deleted. Move the stock first.
